items.title: Hero Motors surges 19% in weak market; zooms 45% in two days on huge volume
items.description: Newly listed Hero Motors share price hit an intra-day high of ₹116.80, up 39% against its issue price of ₹84 per share on the BSE in Thursday's trading session.

items.title: NSE breaks into top 10 BSE market-cap league on debut; beats HUL, Titan
items.description: NSE's market capitalisation increased to ₹4.62 trillion to reach 10th position on the BSE, following a 5% rise in Thursday's debut trading session; beating HUL, Sun Pharma and Titan in ranking.

items.title: CJ Darcl eyes 10% revenue growth, expands into new logistics verticals
